thread:
raj-support: FYI urgent escalation from customer: they say an automated purge job started this morning and legal needs an immediate export + stop on any further deletions. customer: BrightLane (enterprise). timeline requested.

sarah-legal: We need a court-preservation export and a hard pause on deletion for the account. Do not rely on eventual consistency. Need exact list of objects touched and earliest deletion time. :exclamation:

kelly-cs: Customer claim: retention policy was changed 2026-03-10 to 90d -> applied to legacy bucket. Purge window opened 2026-03-17 03:00 UTC. They say ~1.2M objects started tombstoning. We attempted an export via UI but it failed.

raj-support: Can someone confirm whether tombstones are reversible? Also the export failure details attached below (from UI job).

maria-sre: Quick summary from workers: tombstone flag is a metadata mark. There's a two-step: tombstone -> tombstone sweep -> physical deletion. Sweep runs on job cluster prune-batch-1. If sweep hasn't completed physical delete, we can still surface tombstones in export. If tombstones were compacted (physical delete) then need backups.

alan-eng: Repro steps I ran in staging to list tombstones:
```
# list tombstones for acct
GET /v1/internal/objects?account=brightlane&state=tombstoned&limit=1000
```
Response shows metadata with `deleted_at` and `retention_policy_id`.

derek-ops: When customer tried export they hit a KMS error. Attached job log snippet: 
```
export_worker_2026-03-17T03:12:10Z ERROR export: decrypt failed key_id=projects/ksm/keys/rl-prod-01 reason=ACCESS_DENIED
CausedBy: HSM rotation in progress, key temporarily unavailable
```
We need KMS team to confirm whether key rotation blocked access and whether decrypts can be retried.

kms-bot: KMS-Rotation-Service: rotation window for rl-prod-01 started 2026-03-17T02:58Z and completed 2026-03-17T03:05Z. Some cached clients hit a transient DENY until caches refreshed. Recommend retry.

maria-sre: If KMS is transient, export should succeed on retry, provided tombstones still exist. BUT customer says export keeps failing with 403. Need a live attempt from ops with fresh creds.

raj-support: Action items for ops/eng: 1) Attempt export with elevated service principal and include `?include_tombstones=true`. 2) If physical delete already occurred, provide earliest backup snapshot index covering account. 3) Pause sweep queue for account.

derek-ops: I can pause prune-batch-1 for the account: command below (internal runbook):
```
# pause sweep for account
POST /internal/maintenance/pause-sweep
{ "account": "brightlane", "reason": "legal_hold_request_2401234567", "until": "2026-04-01T00:00:00Z" }
```
Will need approval from 2 owners and confirmation that pause only prevents sweep->physical-delete (does not unmark existing tombstones).

sarah-legal: Approve. Please include an immutable export CSV with object ids, created_at, deleted_at, retention_policy_id, and SHA256. We need chain-of-custody.

alan-eng: I'll run the elevated export now and paste logs. If KMS still denies, we can temporarily use the backup export path (uses KMS-delegation-key) and rotate later.

(5m later)

alan-eng: Export attempt result: 
```
POST /internal/export?include_tombstones=true&account=brightlane
200 OK
export_id=exp-2401234567-01
items_logged=1_183_420
status=complete
```
Attached small sample CSV S3 link (internal). :white_check_mark:

kelly-cs: Customer notified. Legal asked for audit log of who changed retention policy on 2026-03-10. Can we pull audit entries for retention_policy.update for that account?

maria-sre: Query audit index: `service=audit action=retention_policy.update account=brightlane` returned one event: `user=ops_autodeploy@redwood` at 2026-03-10T01:04:22Z with payload showing new default_days=90 and migration=true. Link to event: /audits/evt-98765.

raj-support: Great. Also legal wants confirmation whether any objects transitioned from tombstone -> physical delete before pause.

derek-ops: Based on worker logs, prune-batch-1 processed partitions up to prefix `2026/03/17/02` before pause. Rough estimate: ~420k objects physically deleted prior to 02:45 UTC. I've captured a deletion manifest: /manifests/brightlane/deletes/2026-03-17-02.log

sarah-legal: Not ideal but we have some objects deleted. They want a list of deleted object ids and earliest backup that might contain them.

alan-eng: Backups: snapshot service has daily snapshots. The nearest prior snapshot is 2026-03-16T00:00Z. We can restore object bodies from that snapshot if necessary. Need legal sign-off for restore/export of backups.

kelly-cs: I'll coordinate with customer and legal to confirm scope and ask whether they want a full restore or just manifest.

raj-support: Closing loop: paused sweep for brightlane, export succeeded with tombstones included, audit entry found for policy change, deletion manifest for pre-pause deletes captured, backup snapshot identified. Next: legal to confirm whether they want restore requests. Please add any missing artifacts (export link, manifest link, audit event link) into the case ticket.

sarah-legal: Thanks everyone. Please tag me when you upload the immutable CSV to evidence store. :hand:
